notes: The set-theoretic Claim avoids the documented pitfall, but concluding discreteness requires the added, unstated hypothesis (*) that V_m(z) is a neighborhood of z. Take X={0}∪{1/k:k≥1} with its usual subspace topology and well-order 0≺1≺1/2≺⋯, and set every V_m=Δ_X. All stated hypotheses hold and A_n(x)={x}, but every neighborhood of 0 meets infinitely many members of the singleton family. Thus the proof establishes only a version with an additional topological hypothesis.
